author: amase
quote:
It should've been called "Jason & Lucia"  NOT GTA 6
Where did things go wrong? Waiting 13 years for this, only to watch the core identity of the franchise get tossed out the window, is completely insane. Did the developers even ask longtime fans what they actually wanted? The only two things worth praising are the graphics and the size of the map, everything else is horrendous. I genuinely don’t understand how people are giving this a 10 out of 10. We have seen this exact pattern with multiple games in the past, and it’s time to stop pretending it’s acceptable.Look at Monster Hunter. Monster Hunter: Wilds had a rough launch with performance issues and got hit with negative reviews early on, but a couple of months later they patched it and the positive reviews rolled in. The reason I’m using Monster Hunter as an example is because they have stuck to the same core formula for 22 years, and they still make great games. Straying away from the original formula that made your franchise legendary makes zero **** story here is rough and falls completely flat, they honestly should have just stuck with one protagonist. Even worse, why are developers removing features that worked in past games instead of building on them? Stop stripping things out and start adding more content that expands on those features. On top of that, the controls feel clunky, there are noticeable glitches, there’s no autosave, and it runs at 30 FPS. Fix those issues and maybe I’ll bump my score up to a 1 out of 10.Whatever happened to the classic GTA mindset of not caring about rules and doing whatever you want? Sure, you can technically ignore the main missions and mess around in free roam, but if you actually want to unlock features and trigger more world events, you are forced to play through the story. With 13 years of development, the studio could have easily given us way more freedom and player choice. I do not care about the forced couple dynamic at all. Keep Jason and Lucia in the game if you want, but at least give players the option to opt out of the relationship storyline, or include another protagonist we can switch to. After 13 years, they could have given us multiple distinct protagonists and let us shape their personalities, lifestyles, and romantic choices however we wanted. Look at Baldur's Gate 3, those developers managed to build vibrant, engaging characters where you have complete freedom over who they are and who they date, whether straight, gay, or anything else. Here, you have zero say. Honestly, as a straight guy, I would rather have the freedom to make Jason gay than be forced into a scripted romance with Lucia. On top of that, restricting basic sandbox chaos, like locking down weapons inside clubs or heavily policing where you can cause mayhem, completely defeats the point of an open world crime game. Stop forcing players down a narrow path with this controlling mindset.What really killed the soul of this game is the writing and the characters. They aren't just unrealistic, they’re boring and cringe at points. What happened to the raw, unfiltered comedy that made classics like San Andreas and GTA V iconic? Look back at characters like CJ, Franklin, and Trevor, and moments like "Ah ****, here we go again" or Lamar roasting Franklin. That kind of sharp, unhinged dialogue is completely gone. It’s a video game, a fantasy sandbox, not a corporate seminar. Bringing real-world sensitivity rules into a series built on over-the-top satire strips away everything that made it fun in the first place.When the old creative leadership walked out and the writing room shifted to a massive corporate committee heavily dominated by women and modern studio politics, the entire tone changed. Social pressure inside a room like that inevitably sands down every rough edge before it ever makes it into the script. Nobody is pushing boundaries anymore because everyone is terrified of crossing a line. Meanwhile, other games out there let you play through straight-up World War II Axis campaigns or extreme scenarios without blinking, yet GTA, a franchise literally named after a felony, suddenly has to walk on eggshells. It makes no sense. This doesn't feel like the gritty, unapologetic game built for its core male audience anymore, it feels completely sanitized.I could list flaws for the next two hours, but there’s no point putting it all here. Honestly, this feels like it was planned from the day it was announced. The studio knew longtime fans would hate these changes, and they pushed it through anyway. Get over yourselves, bro. We are not here to learn morals and love lessons in a video game, especially in GTA 6. Take that preachy nonsense to another franchise. What have you done to this series? Just remake the past five games at this point. This is the last straw for me. From now on, I am never buying a game without knowing exactly what I’m getting into first, even if it means spoiling the entire story beforehand. I am genuinely appalled.
